name: Minami (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minami town emblem in blue, green and orange: blue and green stylised waves and mountains with an orange sun.
history: Municipal flag of Minami, a town in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 2006.

features.role: Minami town emblem — blue and green stylised waves and mountains with an orange sun
